verses.en: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
verses.pt: Ouvi agora o que o SENHOR diz: Levanta-te, briga com os montes, e ouçam os morros a tua voz.
verses.en_web: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear now to the words of the Lord: Up! put forward your cause before the mountains, let your voice be sounding among the hills.

verses.en: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD’S controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
verses.pt: Ouvi vós, montes, e vós, fortes fundamentos da terra, a briga do SENHOR; porque o SENHOR tem uma briga judicial com seu povo, e disputará judicialmente com Israel.
verses.en_web: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O you mountains, to the Lord's cause, and take note, you bases of the earth: for the Lord has a cause against his people, and he will take it up with Israel.

verses.en: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
verses.pt: Ó povo meu, o que eu tenho feito a ti? Em que eu te incomodei? Responde-me.
verses.en_web: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
verses.en_bbe: O my people, what have I done to you? how have I been a weariness to you? give answer against me.

verses.en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.pt: Pois eu te fiz subir da terra do Egito, e da casa de escravidão eu te livrei; e enviei diante de ti a Moisés, Arão, e Miriã.
verses.en_web: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.en_bbe: For I took you up out of the land of Egypt and made you free from the prison-house; I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

verses.en: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
verses.pt: Ó povo meu, lembra-te agora do Balaque, rei de Moabe, planejou, e do que Balaão, filho de Beor, lhe respondeu, e do que aconteceu desde Sitim até Gilgal, para que conheças as justiças do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: O my people, keep in mind now what was designed by Balak, king of Moab, and the answer which Balaam, son of Beor, gave him; the events, from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may be certain of the upright acts of the Lord.

verses.en: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
verses.pt: Com que me encontrarei com o SENHOR, e adorarei ao alto Deus? Virei diante ele com holocaustos, com bezerros de um ano?
verses.en_web: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
verses.en_bbe: With what am I to come before the Lord and go with bent head before the high God? am I to come before him with burned offerings, with young oxen a year old?

verses.en: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.pt: O SENHOR se agradará de milhares de carneiros, ou de dez mil ribeiros de azeite? Darei meu primogênito por minha transgressão, o fruto de meu ventre pelo pecado de minha alma?
verses.en_web: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.en_bbe: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of sheep or with ten thousand rivers of oil? am I to give my first child for my wrongdoing, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

verses.en: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.pt: Ele já declarou a ti, ó ser humano, o que é bom; e que mais o SENHOR pede de ti, a não ser fazer o que é justo, amar a bondade, e andar humildemente com teu Deus?
verses.en_web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
verses.en_bbe: He has made clear to you, O man, what is good; and what is desired from you by the Lord; only doing what is right, and loving mercy, and walking without pride before your God.

verses.en: The LORD’S voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
verses.pt: A voz do SENHOR clama à cidade (e sábio é temer o teu nome): Ouvi a vara, e a quem a estabeleceu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
verses.en_bbe: The voice of the Lord is crying out to the town: Give ear, you tribes and the meeting of the town.

verses.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
verses.pt: Não há ainda na casa do perverso riquezas da perversidade, e medida enganosamente menor, o que é abominável?
verses.en_web: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
verses.en_bbe: Am I to let the stores of the evil-doer go out of my memory, and the short measure, which is cursed?

verses.en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
verses.pt: Posso eu tolerar quem tem balanças falsas e bolsa de pesos enganosos?
verses.en_web: Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
verses.en_bbe: Is it possible for me to let wrong scales and the bag of false weights go without punishment?

verses.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.pt: Pois seus ricos estão cheios de violência, e seus moradores falaram mentiras, e suas línguas são enganosas em suas bocas.
verses.en_web: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
verses.en_bbe: For its men of wealth are cruel, and its people have said what is not true, and their tongue is false in their mouth.

verses.en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
verses.pt: Por isso eu também te enfraquecerei, ferindo-te e assolando-te por teus pecados.
verses.en_web: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
verses.en_bbe: So I have made a start with your punishment; I have made you waste because of your sins.

verses.en: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
verses.pt: Tu comerás, mas não te saciarás; e fome haverá no meio de ti; tu pegarás, mas não levarás contigo; e o que levares, eu o entregarei à espada.
verses.en_web: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your humiliation will be within you. You will store up, but not save; and that which you save I will give up to the sword.
verses.en_bbe: You will have food, but not enough; your shame will be ever with you: you will get your goods moved, but you will not take them away safely; and what you do take away I will give to the sword.

verses.en: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
verses.pt: Tu semearás, mas não colherás; pisarás azeitonas, mas não te ungirás com óleo; pisarás uvas, mas não beberás vinho.
verses.en_web: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
verses.en_bbe: You will put in seed, but you will not get in the grain; you will be crushing olives, but your bodies will not be rubbed with the oil; and you will get in the grapes, but you will have no wine.

verses.en: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
verses.pt: Pois são os mandamentos de Onri, e todas as obras da casa de Acabe, que são obedecidos; e vós praticais seus conselhos. Por isso eu te tornarei desolada, e teus moradores serão motivo de assovio. Assim levareis a humilhação de meu povo.
verses.en_web: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and her inhabitants a hissing; And you will bear the reproach of my people.”
verses.en_bbe: For you have kept the laws of Omri and all the works of the family of Ahab, and you have been guided by their designs: so that I might make you a cause of wonder and your people a cause of hisses; and the shame of my people will be on you.
